message: docs(status): fold the closed convenience-API work into one current entry

edits.find:
- **The value tier has its transaction, and [#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362) is closed:** [#368](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/368) is merged. `ProjectHandle.values(recipe)` is a second tier beside `edit`, handed a frozen `ValueTransaction` from `contract/`, and it defers the publication rather than the write: `n` writes cost one `invalidate`, one notification per affected node and one sequence move, a staged verb answers a deferred batch naming its own node, and `apps/ik-playground/src/scroll-reach.ts` is one call that no longer says it is not a multi-track transaction. `RA-162` through `RA-169`, recorded in ADR-078. All seven phases of that issue have an outcome on main, and its two remainders are owned elsewhere: the `CITATION_PENDING` ratchet, and [#369](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/369).
- **Runtime surface work landed, phases 2 through 5 of [#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362):** [#365](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/365), [#366](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/366) and [#367](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/367) are merged. `motionIds()`, `freeTrackIds()` and `mountedNodeIds()` enumerate a loaded project in committed order and both demos mount from those answers instead of a hand-written id list; `subscribe`, `adopt` and `destroyAdopted` are deleted with no alias, which takes `TrackEntry.owner` and the `#schemaOwner` sentinel with them; `mountAll` and `unmountAll` are refused on a measurement rather than added, so phase 5 ships four cases and no runtime code. `RA-145` through `RA-161`. ADR-076 records the removal, ADR-020 is superseded rather than left contradicting it, and ADR-077 records the refusal.
edits.replace: - **[#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362) landed whole and is closed:** [#363](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/363) through [#368](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/368) are merged, all seven phases with an outcome on main. A loaded project enumerates itself through `motionIds()`, `freeTrackIds()` and `mountedNodeIds()` and both demos mount from those answers rather than a hand-written id list; `subscribe`, `adopt` and `destroyAdopted` are deleted with no alias; `mountAll` is refused on a measurement rather than added; and the value tier has `ProjectHandle.values(recipe)`, a second tier beside `edit` that defers the publication rather than the write, so `n` writes cost one `invalidate`, one notification per affected node and one sequence move while a staged verb answers a deferred batch naming its node. `RA-145` through `RA-169`, ADR-076 through ADR-078, ADR-020 superseded. Its remainders are the `CITATION_PENDING` ratchet and [#369](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/369).

edits.find: That headroom is where the remaining convenience-API items on [#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362) land.
